text: 1. Course and Purpose: The program is designed to teach spoken Chinese, and a taste of Chinese culture. It aims to improve learners’ communicative skills with oral Chinese and enable them to have a better and more in-depth knowledge of Chinese culture through personal experience. 2. Program Date and Duration: The program is offered for four weeks from January to February, July to August.Please note that we offer flexible program dates for a group of 10 or above. 3.
